_comment: Catalogue of maps shown by the demo. Each entry points to a map file in this folder. Add a map by adding an entry here and a JSON file next to it.

title.en: Complete Map of the Myriad Countries of the World

maps.creator: Matteo Ricci 利瑪竇, with Li Zhizao 李之藻
maps.repository: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division
maps.summary: Woodblock print on six sheets, the third edition of Ricci's Chinese world map. Chinese inscriptions throughout: title, prefaces, cosmological diagrams and hundreds of place names.

title.zh: 米勒地圖集 第四葉
title.en: Nautical Atlas of the World (Miller Atlas), folio 4

maps.creator: Lopo Homem, Pedro and Jorge Reinel; illuminated by António de Holanda
maps.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France (via Library of Congress / World Digital Library)
maps.summary: A vellum sheet painted on both sides: the recto shows the Magnus Sinus (the Great Gulf of the Chinese sea), the verso the China Sea with the Moluccas. Latin cartouches on both faces.
